constraints: repetition count fixed at **3**, APIs fixed at **31 and 36**
All eight scenarios and both APIs must appear.

orderedPrerequisites.requires: Phase 2 ownership implementation; do not use preflight as ownership

orderedPrerequisites.preserve: original seeding and live synthetic authentication
verified original software cohort, guest resources and animation settings
original per-API build frequency and --no-daemon policy until matched baselines exist
complete default datasets; real internal and removable storage
same parameter assembly as workspace; never serialize credential arguments

comparisonPolicy.externalPrerequisiteTime: separate phase, included once in invocation wall accounting
comparisonPolicy.failedSamples: retain; cohort incomplete; diagnostic rerun never replaces scheduled sample
comparisonPolicy.cohorts: match actual CPU/GPU/renderer, host/API/image/tools, fixtures, resources, animations and cache policy; configuration experiments separate
comparisonPolicy.sourceChanges: declare app/helper changes independently of stable workload definition

orderedPrerequisites.policy: restore all mutable device trees and remote recheck tree before each independent repetition; do not shrink immutable datasets

orderedPrerequisites.parameters: private live protocol credentials, derived byte sizes, API_LEVEL and complete scroll-manifest output

resetPolicy.inFlowSetup: retain the complete existing form/seam, real picker, navigation and scan sequence
resetPolicy.externalFixtureReset: before repetition; not inside its measured flow
resetPolicy.staged: never apply independent reset between staged continuation parts
